The '''shaclaws''', known on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]] as '''Rishi Shore crabs''', were massive, armored [[Insect/Legends|insectoids]] native to [[Voss]] and [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].

==Description==
Shaclaws possessed powerful foreclaws able to tear through the flesh and armor of their foes. They also used these foreclaws to burrow into the earth to find roots and subterranean [[Mammal/Legends|mammals]] to feed upon.<ref name="codex" /> Their carapace was highly resilient, and was valued as a hunters' trophy.<ref name="Beach's Bounty" />

A visually similar, and perhaps relative, species of [[Cryo-nester]]s, while having the same musculoskeletal system, evolved to thrive in completely different environment.<ref name="Glacial">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Glacial Trespass]]|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>

==Shaclaws in the galaxy==
===Voss===
Shaclaws were considered a delicacy by the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]], but would secrete deadly toxins after they [[Death/Legends|died]]. As a result, they had to be specially cooked while alive. It was noted however, that Gormak only dine on shaclaws during special coming of age feasts in which the capture and preparation of the meal is considered an essential part of the ritual celebration.<ref name="codex" />

===Rishi===
On [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], shaclaws were known as '''Rishi Shore crabs'''. They lived near [[Water/Legends|water]], in island rivers or around ocean [[Beach/Legends|beaches]]. Similarly as on Voss, they used toxin secretion as a means of defense.<ref name="Rishi">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=location|[[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]}}</ref> Shaclaws of Rishi liked [[Orobird/Legends|Orobird]]s' eggs, which was known to skilled hunters who used the eggs as a bait to lure shaclaws out of the water.<ref name="Beach's Bounty">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=general|Beach's Bounty|[[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]}}</ref> 

A subspecies of the Rishi Shore crab existed, known as '''Giant Rishi Mud crab'''.<ref name="carapace">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=item|Mud Crab Carapace|"Beach's Bounty" mission on [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]}}</ref> These creatures hid underwater, leaving only their prolonged tongues, called ''feelers'', above the surface. Prey in proximity of such a feeler would swiftly become a victim of a surprise attack by a Giant Rishi mud crab.<ref name="Beach's Bounty" />

===Ord Mantell===
A miniature [[Subspecies/Legends|subspecies]] of shaclaw, known as ''spikeshell'', was a variety living on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], seen in great numbers at the area of the [[Kessan's Landing]].<ref name="Kessan's Landing" /> Shaclaws were also among several [[Species/Legends|species]] gathered for experimentation on the [[Lost Island]] by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sannus Lorrick]]. The modified [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]] he conceived, became capable of infecting shaclaws.<ref name="Lost Island">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The Lost Island}}</ref>

===Other===
Captive shaclaws were kept on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] experimented with breeding cybernetically weaponized shaclaws to use against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Presumably transplanted wild populations of shaclaws existed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].<ref name="TOR" />

Shaclaw species gave a name to a [[Shaclaw (swoop)|Shaclaw swoop]] produced by [[Roche Hive Mechanical Apparatus Design and Construction Activity for Those Who Need the Hive's Machines/Legends|ROCHE]].<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=other|Mount: "Roche Shaclaw"}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Despite 3D model of shaclaw being reused on several planets in [[Star Wars: The Old Republic]], the codex entry describes cultural significance of shaclaws to [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]], which, considering that planet [[Voss]] wasn't rediscovered by the Galaxy until very recently in the game's timeline, gives enough information to state that at least on [[Voss]] shaclaws have been present long before the events of the game take place. On every other planet, shaclaws should be presumed imported from Voss after its rediscovery, or have a history tracing back to the time when Voss was first discovered, when shaclaws could be imported either to or from Voss.
